# `network/realm/governance/OrganizationLedger.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/governance/OrganizationLedger.js`

Cryptographically verified organization history. The ledger uses the same contextual verifier for live persistence and replay. A proposal freezes its eligible membership set and quorum at its epoch; later joins cannot vote, while revoked members and superseded keys fail immediately.
